verdict.rationale: Cactus ships an official CLI, installable via Homebrew (`brew install cactus-compute/cactus/cactus`). It has documented subcommands: `cactus run`, `cactus convert`, `cactus benchmark` and `needle whistle compare`. The platform docs list the CLI alongside the dashboard, Python and coding agents as a supported way to run hosted jobs. Missing for 10: a full command reference for the platform CLI, evidence of agent-oriented features such as machine-readable output or non-interactive auth, and any independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI.
